title: Sleep and Muscle Adaptation
subtitle: How sleep and muscle adaptation are connected, what the evidence shows, and what matters in practice.
evidence_strength: Moderate evidence from randomized controlled and observational studies supports a significant role of sleep in muscle adaptation. Emerging research investigates specific molecular pathways and circadian interactions. Limitations include heterogeneity of study populations and methods.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
